name: Winding Cavern
author: voodoo573
description: A large natural cave of winding passages and rock pillars, with scattered boulders, patches of glowing fungi and a dark underground pool in the north-east corner. Generated with a cellular-automaton cave algorithm. 26 x 20 squares at 64 px per 5-ft square.
summary: Natural cave with winding passages, pillars, fungi and a pool.
credits: Original battle map created for the Hearth Community repository by voodoo573 (2026), drawn procedurally with a Python/PIL script; no third-party art used. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
